Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up prototype 0004–0017 normal save through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. Mt. Moon is converted. Route 4 is the next development area and remains unconverted. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Mt. Moon includes Yellow’s trainer teams, cave encounters, Super Nerd fossil battle, one exclusive fossil choice, and Jessie/James’s fossil ambush. Jessie and James have their own overworld sprites and Yellow’s paired battle portrait; the fossils have distinct ground graphics. The nearby Center heals Pokémon, provides shared player PC storage, and offers one level-5 Magikarp for 500 Pokédollars. Cave rewards include reusable Water Gun and Mega Punch TMs. Bulk Rare Candy use now offers a quantity picker, applies the batch, processes intermediate moves, and checks evolution once at the end. Normal four-move replacement choices still appear. All earlier features carry forward. Keep a backup of your ordinary save before switching builds; emulator save states are specific to their ROM version. Earlier downloads remain available separately.
